headline: Indo Us Biotech submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine paperwork filed by Indo Us Biotech
summary: Indo Us Biotech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate compliance filing required after shareholder meetings. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update has no financial or operational impact on the company.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your holdings.

headline: Indo Us Biotech informs exchange about annual general meeting proceedings
hook: Routine AGM concluded at Indo Us Biotech
summary: Indo Us Biotech Limited has submitted the details regarding the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026.
